With minor differences, this is a duplicate feature request, and can be merged with:

- https://feedback.vrchat.com/feature-requests/p/returning-audio-sources-to-quest-devices-and-how-id-imagine-it

- https://feedback.vrchat.com/feature-requests/p/quest-audio

- (possibly many more other requests)

Per [Android Content Limitations](https://creators.vrchat.com/platforms/android/quest-content-limitations/): "Audio sources are disabled completely for avatars on Android and Quest. Audio sources consume a significant amount of CPU resources and voices have priority."

details:
There should be audio for avatars on the quest! 

I know that it may cause Lag and eat the Ram but maybe a toggle button to turn sound effects for avatars on and off may be the solution or maybe just avatar audio from friends might also work as a feature. Please us Quest users ars always missing out with no audio the experience in Vrchat are much more less fun and boring.      Recap:    

 

[Add on and off buttons for avatar audio]

[Be able to hear avatar audio just from ur friends for better processing and less Ram usage]

(thise wasnt in the text but i thought of it)

[Limitate the amount of sound affects that cann be played at once so it cann be processed better, such as an cooldown or something. 3-4 Audios and then a 20-40 second cooldown before being able to hear again]

I really wish that you cann make thise happen.
title: (Quest) Audio for avatars
